アピールしてくれてありがとう！あなたのアートスタイルは、私のOCサロスにぴったりです！

以下、彼女の情報です：
-サロスは愛の力を持つ悪魔のような魔法少女です。(例えば、人をマッチメイクすることができ、それを使って攻撃することもできる)。
-魔法少女であることに情熱的でエネルギッシュ。でも不器用なところもある。
-鳥と花が好き！

その他、細かいことはお任せします。あなたの作品を楽しみにしています！

https://file.garden/ZSYsvGbTJ3TtdvKW/sallos_ref.png

Hi! I saw your request of this! 'Nice to meet you. My name is Eve Aoto and I am an illustrator. I saw your OC on skeb. I found it very attractive and wanted to draw it, so I sent him a message. The fox ears and tail are so cute! The contrast between the silvery fur and the dark kimono is wonderful. If I were to draw her, I wanted to draw her with snow as a motif, or maybe with flowers.
ou can check out my illustrations on X. I'm good at colorful pictures and sparkling pictures. I usually draw illustrations for YouTube as part of my work. (https://x.com/mnmn3_ao) I would be happy if I could have a chance with you! Thank you for reading this far.'

I agree to your request and would leave the design, character pose etc to your own imagination. You may change the outfit if you like too. 

I would love something similiar to your previous work of 'https://x.com/mnmn3_ao/status/1872941856314802630' for the song cover of '白い雪のプリンセスは' Thank you!
